summary: Moves rich-text sanitising and allowed image types into a new app/Functions/validation.php + config/validation.php (DOM-based sanitizer; image types now include gif and SVG for avatars, backgrounds, admin logo/favicon and JSON import), adds validation to admin edit-user and admin site uploads. But it also deletes the end of app/Functions/functions.php, leaving footer() unclosed (PHP parse error in an autoloaded file) and removing the block helper functions (setBlockAssetContext, block_asset, block_text, bt, ...) that are still used.

statements.why: The commit really breaks the site and opens SVG uploads; the count matches the four real items below.

statements.text: ✖ setBlockAssetContext() was deleted from app/Functions/functions.php, but app/Http/Controllers/LinkTypeViewController.php and resources/views/linkstack/elements/buttons.blade.php still use it, so those pages will crash.
statements.why: Still called at LinkTypeViewController.php:51 and buttons.blade.php:14.

statements.text: ✖ block_text_translation_check() was deleted from app/Functions/functions.php, but resources/views/studio/edit-link.blade.php still uses it, so those pages will crash.
✖ app/Functions/functions.php looks cut off: some of its { brackets are never closed, so it no longer runs. Every page that loads it will crash. Ask the agent to restore the end of the file.
statements.why: footer() is left unclosed; functions.php is a composer 'files' autoload, so every request hits the parse error.

statements.text: ⚠ Uploads now accept SVG files (in app/Functions/validation.php and config/validation.php). An SVG can carry a script that runs when someone opens it from your site, so one user could attack others, admins included. Leave SVG out, or serve uploaded files from a separate domain.
statements.why: config/validation.php image_extensions includes 'svg' for avatars/backgrounds; stored XSS risk is real (import-data base64 path not mentioned).

statements.text: • The agent changed the admin edit user, admin site, studio page, studio background and import data parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what they do differently.
statements.why: These handlers did change (validation, sanitizer, SVG support), but nothing is explained.
Adds app/Functions/validation.php to autoload files; needs composer dump-autoload, not mentioned.
File inputs get accept= from the configured image list.
Profile picture inputs now accept configured types incl. .svg/.gif.
Background input now accepts configured types incl. .svg.

misses.what: Admin 'Edit user' now rejects saves when the password box is left empty (or the user has no page handle/email), because empty fields become null and fail the new 'string' rules.
Profile/page descriptions and text blocks now go through a stricter HTML sanitizer that drops all attributes except safe link hrefs (improves XSS protection; may strip some formatting).
Needs `composer dump-autoload` on deploy so the new validation.php is loaded; otherwise new helper calls are undefined.
